title.ko: 이야기 쓰기: 과거 시제 · 시간 연결어 · 형용사와 부사
title.en: telling a story: past tenses, time linkers, adjectives and adverbs

explain.ko: 이야기를 쓸 때는 과거형으로 사건을 순서대로 말하고(I found a wallet), 과거진행형으로 배경이나 그때 하고 있던 일을 말하며(I was looking around), 과거완료로 그 전에 있던 일을 말합니다(I had lost it earlier). 시간 연결어로 흐름을 만듭니다: one day, then, after that, suddenly, while, in the end, ever since. 형용사(frightening)와 부사(quietly, luckily)를 넣으면 이야기가 생생해집니다.
explain.en: In a story use the past simple for the main events (I found a wallet), the past continuous for the background or what was happening (I was looking around) and the past perfect for what had happened earlier (I had lost it earlier). Time linkers give the story a flow: one day, then, after that, suddenly, while, in the end, ever since. Adjectives (frightening) and adverbs (quietly, luckily) make it vivid.

notes.ko: while 뒤에는 보통 과거진행형, when 뒤에는 짧은 사건을 쓰는 경우가 많습니다.
notes.en: While usually takes the past continuous; when often introduces a short event.

notes.ko: 이야기의 시작 · 갑작스러운 사건 · 결말 순으로 구성하세요.
notes.en: Organise a story as: beginning, sudden event, ending.

notes.ko: luckily, fortunately 같은 부사는 문장 앞에 쓰고 쉼표를 찍습니다.
notes.en: Sentence adverbs like luckily go at the start with a comma.

task.model: One day I found a wallet in the street. While I was looking around, suddenly a man ran up. He said it was his wallet. Luckily, his name was inside, so I gave it back. In the end we became friends.

model_trans.ko: 어느 날 나는 길에서 지갑을 발견했어요. 내가 주변을 둘러보는 동안 갑자기 한 남자가 달려왔어요. 그는 그 지갑이 자기 것이라고 말했어요. 다행히 안에 이름이 있어서 돌려주었어요. 결국 우리는 친구가 되었어요.
model_trans.en: One day I found a wallet in the street. While I was looking around, suddenly a man ran up. He said it was his wallet. Luckily, his name was inside, so I gave it back. In the end we became friends.
